supersedes: V33 request revision 3 rejected by its native-200 preview because the recording microphone and wireless dock fell outside the target safe area
purpose: CANCELED audit record. This request would have generated three separate dedicated functional-face source cells, but the owner replaced that architecture with the locked V9 daily face plus deterministic event-overlay components.
cancellation_reason: COMP-REQ-187: functional activity is an art-derived causal overlay over the living daily face, not a dedicated functional facial pose. No source produced by this request may be imported, used visually, exported, bound or flashed.

source_shape.target_normalization: each cell anchors its two V9 eyes to the canonical native 200x200 eye centers before safety inspection
source_shape.do_not_combine_before: each individual cell passes label-hidden native-200 target-safe placement inspection

shared_facial_performance_contract: use exact V9 eye identity while giving each state a separately extractable highlight direction, brow pose and mouth mask
menu enter: upward-right acknowledgement highlights, alert asymmetrical lifted brows and tiny closed decision mouth
recording input: rightward listening highlights, gently drawn-in brows and narrow closed listening mouth with a small white breath gap
wireless charging: high-inward relaxed highlights, lower wider restorative brows and small rounded upturn mouth with white inner gap
props validate the state but may not replace these facial differences
source_preview_gate: each source cell renders without cropping its required object boxes after native eye normalization
each source cell is readable with labels hidden and has a correct causal direction
only then may the three cells appear in one review sheet; no component or runtime export occurs before a passing V33 source gate
